summary: Bound gateway process admission under overload

delivery.outcome: Publish a bounded gateway registry subprocess admission fix with separate execution/control capacity and deterministic overload errors, validated without production deployment.
nonGoals: Changes to preserved tickets 051/052 or tests PR7

architecture.decision: Nonblocking bounded semaphores at the registry subprocess boundary; execution and control use separate slots. Reject overload before spawning, release slots in finally, classify failed registry output and OS resource errors. Environment limits are operator configuration, not request-controlled.
interfaceChanges: HTTP 503 BUSY for saturated gateway registry capacity; HTTP 502 for unclassified failed results
architecture.rollback: Revert the code change; no state migration and no live configuration changes.

validation.evidence: Deterministic concurrent admission tests, HTTP status tests, isolated real gateway burst and receipt counts.
